head: Look up your member
deck: Public records involving Anthropic, its people and PAC, its funders, the groups they fund and their lobbyists. Members serving on Nov. 26, 2026. Records through Sep. 30, 2026.
note: Campaign gifts go to linked committees. Their filings tell you nothing about votes. Lobbying reports can name bills without stating a position or showing contact with a sponsor.

head: Most members with a record have one or two kinds
deck: 232 of the 454 members with a counted record have one or two kinds. Martin Heinrich and Ted Lieu share the most kinds on file, with 7.
note: Each kind counts once, regardless of the number of records or dollars. A critical statement or spending against a member can count.
bridge: What if the only record is spending against them?
how: All 533 serving members, including those with no counted record.

head: Spending against a member can put them on the list.
deck: For Thom Tillis, opposition spending is the only kind of record in this collection.
